name: Snowy-cheeked Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Southwestern china (montane forest of southern gansu and adjacent sichuan)
description: Brown laughingthrush with a gray wing patch and snowy white cheek. Localized and uncommon even in its restricted range, where it is typically found on the ground and in the undergrowth of coniferous and mixed forests.

name: Jamaican Euphonia
rangeDescription: Woodland and scrub of jamaica
description: A very small and active inhabitant of most wooded habitats and gardens where it forages mostly on fruits and flowers. Note this species’ short, stubby bill, and mostly gray head and underparts.

name: Southern Martin
rangeDescription: Bolivia to uruguay and argentina; winters to north to colombia
description: Large swallow with pointed wings and slightly forked tail. Males are deep iridescent purple; females are also entirely dark, but are brownish below, with faint scaling.

name: Gang-gang Cockatoo
rangeDescription: Coastal southeastern australia (central new south wales to southeastern south australia)
description: Small and compact cockatoo found only in southeastern Australia. Primarily scaly gray-green; adult male has bright red ‘helmet’ and fluffy crest.

name: Pesquet's Parrot
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed mountains of new guinea
description: A large, primitive parrot of lower-montane, foothill and nearby lowland primary forest. Unparrotlike, long, pointy head.

name: Club-winged Manakin
rangeDescription: West slope of andes of southwestern colombia and western ecuador
description: Unique and entertaining manakin found in lush cloud forest in western Ecuador and western Colombia. Wine-red, black, and white male is unlike any other species in range.

name: Luzon Rail
rangeDescription: Montane north-central luzon (northern philippines); few recent records
description: A mysterious medium-sized rail, possibly of foothill or montane grassy areas and forests. Dark brown above with a pale gray chest, a whitish throat, a barred belly, blackish legs, and a fairly long, curved reddish bill.

name: South American Tern
rangeDescription: Coasts and islands of southern south america and falkland islands
description: Medium-sized tern, mostly restricted to coastal areas. In breeding plumage, strikingly pale gray above and below with an extensive black cap, and an unmarked red bill and legs.

name: Damara Red-billed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Central namibia (southern damaraland)
description: Fairly small, slim, long-tailed hornbill. Note the red bill, dark eye, pale face, and heavily spotted back.

name: Green Rosella
rangeDescription: Tasmania and larger islands in bass strait
description: Restricted to Tasmania. Large green and yellow rosella with blue cheek patches and wings.

name: Madagascar Blue-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Humid forest of eastern madagascar
description: Medium-sized chunky pigeon that is dark blue with a maroon tail. Appears short-tailed in flight.

name: Buller's Shearwater
rangeDescription: Breeds islands off new zealand; wide trans-pacific dispersal
description: Striking large shearwater with distinctive dark

name: Wrenthrush
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: A strange little understory bird, unmistakable if seen well. Plump and very short-tailed, like a small antpitta or wren.

name: Mayotte Sunbird
rangeDescription: Mayotte island (comoros)
description: A small sunbird with a relatively short, slightly downcurved bill. Males are a beautiful mix of green, purple, red, and yellow.

name: Spot-winged Starling
rangeDescription: Foothills of northern india and nepal; winters to myanmar and thailand
description: Uncommon pale-eyed starling with a white patch on each wing. Male is metallic dark blue-gray above with an orange breast and belly.

name: Speke's Weaver
rangeDescription: Southern ethiopia to somalia, kenya, and northern tanzania
description: A chunky, short-tailed, long-billed weaver of dry country. Breeding males are mostly yellow with a black face mask, a pale eye, and a heavily streaked back.

name: White-fronted Falconet
rangeDescription: Forest of northern borneo
description: Tiny, compact, black-and-white falcon. Black above, with a white chest and pale orangish belly.

name: Jamaican Lizard-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Jamaica
description: An impressive long-tailed bird of moist mid-elevation woodlands including secondary growth, where it feeds in the understory by peeking and probing into vegetation in pursuit of insects and lizards. Generally solitary and secretive, but not shy.

name: Yellow-throated Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to southern venezuela, the guianas, northern brazil, and northern peru
description: Medium-sized, active flycatcher of forest canopy; often observed on the periphery of mixed-species flocks. When seen well, note entirely yellow underparts, including throat.

name: Buru Golden-Bulbul
rangeDescription: Buru island (southern moluccas)
description: A thrush-sized olive-colored songbird with a long, fairly heavy bill. Plumage uniform olive-green except for narrow yellow chin, yellow patch between the bill and the eye, and partial yellow eye-ring above the eye.
